    public IReadOnlyList<Course> GetCourses(string? search = null, int? departmentId = null)
    {

        if (departmentId.HasValue)

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
        {
            var term = search.Trim();
            result = result.Where(c =>
                c.Title.Contains(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                c.Code.Contains(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                c.Description.Contains(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        return result.ToList();

The Blazor Web App is ready at `UniversityCourseCatalog/`. Here's what was built:

**Pages:**
- **Home** (`/`) — Featured courses cards + department links with "View Courses" buttons
- **Courses** (`/courses`) — Searchable, filterable table with text search + department dropdown
- **Course Detail** (`/courses/{id}`) — Full description, schedule, room, credits, and instructor bio card with "Enroll" button
- **Enroll** (`/enroll`) — Standard HTML form (name, student ID, course dropdown) with confirmation message

**Architecture:**
- Static SSR (no SignalR/WebSocket — appropriate for fast intranet)
- `CatalogService` — singleton with 12 courses across 5 departments (CS, Math, English, Physics, History)
- Bootstrap layout with sidebar navigation
- No authentication, open to all visitors

**Run it:** `cd UniversityCourseCatalog && dotnet run`
